error.summary: A new choice-distance shortcut answers three of five delivered batch items without mixture modeling. The earlier median and source-replay defects are repaired. Package files remained unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Construct and solve a variable-volume mixture model, determine overflow time, and evaluate solute mass there.
reasoning_steps: Calculate volume growth and overflow time.
Solve using an integrating factor and initial condition.
Evaluate at overflow, round, and select the mass.
invariants: Well-mixed tank with constant feed concentration and flow rates.
Capacity exceeds initial volume; inflow exceeds outflow.
permitted_variations: Vary physical quantities while recomputing dependent content.
Vary context, numerical rank, display position, and distractor configuration.

source_replay.details: All eleven observed banks, keys, and omissions replay. Author checks detect old failing controls and pass current code.

math.details: Exact ODE, initial-condition, endpoint, and rounded-answer checks pass; 21 displayed solutions were independently checked.

variety.details: Ranks vary, but fixed distractor distances reveal the answer in a recognizable subgroup, including three actual batch items.

scope.details: Tested easy variants preserve the source method, overflow endpoint, and response workload.

grading.details: Native grading accepted 26 independently calculated correct choices and rejected 104 distractors. Four shortcut-produced submissions were also accepted.

rendering.details: Actual UI rendering and screenshot inspection covered 23 records, including the batch, controlled pairs, and minimal failure.

packaging.details: Exact dependencies, relocation, deterministic replay, and boundary rejection pass. Package snapshots match.

decision_variation.details: A unique choice within 2 lb of every other choice necessarily identifies the key. Delivery preserves this bypass. Ten historical median-affected inventory records remain documented separately.

findings.description: Every normal distractor is within 2 lb of the correct mass. Whenever exactly one displayed choice is within 2 lb of all others, that choice must be correct. This bypass succeeds on 5/44 independent samples and 3/5 delivered batch records.
